thread:
sara_release: Kicking off staged rollout r_2026_03_15_22 for service inference-v2. Starting at 10% -> target 100% over 12m. Tag: v2.3.1. Change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Telemetry spike thresholds enabled.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: rollout_id=rr-88412 service=inference-v2 percent=10 -> 100 plan=(10,20,40,100) initiated by sara_release

matt_eng: watching latency dashboards, will grab traces if anything moves

gina_sre: Alert at 22:12 UTC — p95 latency for inference-v2 jumped 120ms -> 330ms at 20% traffic. Grafana: https://grafana.company/r/inference-v2/p95 :eyes:

kevin_prod: saw a customer report ~500ms tail for 2 requests around 22:11, flagged to support

sara_release: Pausing rollout. Hold at 20%. @deploy-bot please pause rr-88412 — manual hold for investigation

deploy-bot: rollout rr-88412 paused at 20% by sara_release (reason: manual_hold)

olivia_pm: copy — can we get exact model artifact and quantization level for the note? need for release updates

matt_eng: quick trace shows kernel failures on one GPU group (g-rtx-a100-4). errors include `cudaKernelTimeout` and retries. looks like a kernel/hotpath mismatch with quantized kernels

gina_sre: `kubectl logs inference-v2-84f -c worker` shows repeated `OOMKilled` for worker-2 around 22:10-22:13. no crashloop yet but restarts happened

sara_release: decision required: rollback to v2.3.0 or pin v2.3.1 to 0% and fix? rollback to v2.3.0 buys time and should restore perf. @matt_eng?

matt_eng: agree rollback is fastest. triggering emergency rollback to stable v2.3.0 now. command: `/deploy rollback inference-v2 --to v2.3.0 --immediate --reason "canary latency spike"`

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for inference-v2 to v2.3.0 by matt_eng. Traffic: 20% -> 0% -> stable on v2.3.0 (est ~3m). rollback_id=rb-9921

gina_sre: I'll monitor GPU mem/oom and node metrics during rollback, ping if anything else surfaces

kevin_prod: i'll send a quick note to the affected account and open a support ticket, will include rollback timestamp

sara_release: also pin v2.3.1 to prevent auto-retries while we investigate: `/deploy pin inference-v2 --version v2.3.1 --state pinned --note "blocked after canary latency"`

deploy-bot: version v2.3.1 pinned for inference-v2 by sara_release (state=pinned)

matt_eng: rollback complete — deploy-bot reports rb-9921 completed in 2m45s. p95 back to ~118ms. rolling monitoring looks green

gina_sre: no further OOM events seen post-rollback. will run heap/kv cache dump tomorrow for deep analysis

sara_release: next steps: 1) postmortem + perf traces, 2) preflight stress + kernel verification on g-rtx-a100-4, 3) reattempt canary with smaller batch-size and new kernel. I'll open a change window for tomorrow 22:00 UTC and a follow-up rollback playbook note. Release notes draft: https://docs.company/releases/inference-v2 (will update)

olivia_pm: thanks — i'll update customer comms and edit release notes draft with the rollback note.

matt_eng: FYI I'll include the failing trace samples and the `kubectl` output in the postmortem.

sara_release: thanks team. marking this rollout as aborted and creating incident ticket INC-2026-224 for follow-up. :thumbsup:
summary: Staged rollout for inference-v2 (v2.3.1) paused due to p95 latency spike at 20%. Team paused rollout, initiated rollback to v2.3.0, pinned v2.3.1, and outlined next steps (postmortem, preflight, reattempt).
